plan.notes: Source: Blinn College District official Construction Management AAS program map (blinn.edu/academics/degree-certificates/construction-management-aas.html), the current award plan referenced by the 2024-2025 Catalog Vol. 85. The page states: 'Use this Program Map as an advising guide... The map provides students a suggested course sequence to timely program completion.' Semester-by-semester plan transcribed exactly: 15/15/15/15 = 60 credits. Choice slots transcribed with the award plan's wording; the MATH slot ('Any Math Course in the Core Curriculum') publishes no course list, transcribed honestly with empty options. The plan is a suggested sequence. No courses invented.
